basic_details.job_title: ANGRAU Teaching Associate (Genetics and Plant Breeding) Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University (ANGRAU) will hold a walk-in interview on 4 December 2026 (Friday) at Agricultural College, Naira, Srikakulam (Dist.) for one post of Teaching Associate in the Department of Genetics and Plant Breeding. Candidates must register their names before 9.30 AM at the Office of the Associate Dean, Agricultural College, Naira, and the interview is at 10.30 AM. The post is purely temporary and contractual, for not more than 11 months, and pays Rs. 61,000/- per month + applicable HRA for Master's Degree holders or Rs.67,000/- per month + applicable HRA for Ph.D

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 40 years for men and 45 years for women. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age or any category-wise age relaxation.

important_instructions: The engagement ends automatically after completion of 11 months or on the filling of regular staff by the University, whichever is earlier. The incumbent shall have no claim or right to any regular appointment in the University or any government organization. The incumbent shall have no claim or right to further continuation of contractual service. Concealing of facts or canvassing in any form shall lead to disqualification at the time of selection or termination even during the contractual engagement period. Contractual engagements can be terminated at any time without prior notice or assigning any reason. The engaged person may leave the contractual service by giving one-month notice, otherwise one-month salary is to be paid before leaving. Selected candidates must undergo a medical examination at their own expense, as per the rules, before appointment. No T.A & D.A will be given to candidates appearing for the interview. The Associate Dean has the right to cancel or postpone the interview for the said date due to any unavoidable circumstances.

content_sections.heading: About ANGRAU Teaching Associate
content_sections.text: The walk-in has been announced by the Associate Dean of Agricultural College, Naira, a college of Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University in Srikakulam district. The selected Teaching Associate will work in the Department of Genetics and Plant Breeding of the college. A copy of the notice has been sent to the Registrar, ANGRAU, LAM, Guntur – 522 034 with a request to display it on the ANGRAU website, and to other ANGRAU colleges and research stations for their notice boards.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: There is one post of Teaching Associate in the Department of Genetics and Plant Breeding. The engagement is purely temporary, on a contractual basis, not exceeding a period of 11 months. The tenure is 11 months from the date of joining or until the filling of the regular post, whichever is earlier. The notice lists the essential qualifications as follows: a) Ph.D. in the relevant subject, or b) Master's Degree in relevant subject. c) Bachelor's Degree of 4/5 years having first division or equivalent overall grade point average. d) Experience for at least 3 years of respective teaching / research experience as evidenced from Fellowship/Associateship/Training/other engagements. e) Published one research paper in Science Citation Index (SCI)/ NAAS rated ≥4.0 journals. f) Candidates having a post graduate degree in Basic Sciences with 3 years Bachelor's degree and 2 years Master's degree should have the NET qualification. The upper age limit is 40 years for men and 45 years for women. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age or any category-wise age relaxation. HRA will be given as per the existing State Government rates applicable in various places/locations and is subject to change from time to time as per Government orders. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Filled-in application All original certificates One set (photocopy) of all certificates Publications Any other relevant documents

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Register your name before 9.30 AM on 4 December 2026 at the Office of the Associate Dean, Agricultural College, Naira. Hand in the filled-in application along with the original certificates and the set of photocopies, publications and other relevant documents. Appear for the interview at 10.30 AM at Agricultural College, Naira, Srikakulam (Dist.). The decision of the selection committee for the post will be final and binding in all respects.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement ends automatically after completion of 11 months or on the filling of regular staff by the University, whichever is earlier. The incumbent shall have no claim or right to any regular appointment in the University or any government organization. The incumbent shall have no claim or right to further continuation of contractual service. Concealing of facts or canvassing in any form shall lead to disqualification at the time of selection or termination even during the contractual engagement period. Contractual engagements can be terminated at any time without prior notice or assigning any reason. The engaged person may leave the contractual service by giving one-month notice, otherwise one-month salary is to be paid before leaving. Selected candidates must undergo a medical examination at their own expense, as per the rules, before appointment. No T.A & D.A will be given to candidates appearing for the interview. The Associate Dean has the right to cancel or postpone the interview for the said date due to any unavoidable circumstances.

faq.question: Q1. When is the ANGRAU Teaching Associate walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 4 December 2026 (Friday) at Agricultural College, Naira, Srikakulam (Dist.).

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time for the walk-in?
faq.answer: Candidates must register their names before 9.30 AM at the Office of the Associate Dean, Agricultural College, Naira; the interview is at 10.30 AM.

faq.question: Q3. How many Teaching Associate posts are vacant?
faq.answer: There is 01 post of Teaching Associate in the Department of Genetics and Plant Breeding.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the ANGRAU Teaching Associate post?
faq.answer: The notice requires a Ph.D. or Master's Degree in the relevant subject, a 4/5-year Bachelor's Degree with first division or equivalent OGPA, at least 3 years of teaching/research experience and one paper in SCI/NAAS rated ≥4.0 journals; Basic Sciences PG holders (3+2 years) need NET.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years for men and 45 years for women.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of an ANGRAU Teaching Associate?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 61,000/- per month + applicable HRA for Master's Degree holders and Rs.67,000/- per month + applicable HRA for Ph.D degree holders.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, applicable HRA is paid in addition, at the existing State Government rates for the place, subject to change as per Government orders.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring to the walk-in?
faq.answer: Bring a filled-in application, all original certificates and one set of photocopies of all certificates, publications and any other relevant documents.

faq.question: Q9. How will the candidate be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through the walk-in interview, and the decision of the selection committee will be final and binding in all respects.

faq.question: Q10. Is the ANGRAU Teaching Associate post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is purely temporary and contractual for not more than 11 months, ending earlier if the regular post is filled, with no claim to regular appointment or continuation.
